semiconductor_relevance: High — Eulitha specializes in lithography systems and technologies that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Eulitha develops low-cost lithography systems utilizing their Phable technology, which supports various wafer sizes for both R&D and high-volume production. Their Displacement Talbot Lithography (DTL) technology enables high-resolution printing of complex patterns essential for semiconductor applications.
capabilities: PhableR: Manual lithography system for R&D and low volume production
PhableX: Automatic cassette-to-cassette lithography system for ~200mm wafers
PhableS: Step and repeat lithography system for high volume production up to ~300mm wafers
High-resolution printing of sub-micron period linear gratings and 2D patterns
